scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: MLCommons Sets Participation Record with New MLPerf Inference v6.1 Benchmark Results
papers.abstract: Adds end-to-end RAG and edge agentic inference benchmarks. 30 submitting organizations; DeepSeek R1 best per-accelerator server performance 5.7x over v5.1; VLM 2.99x over v6.0.
papers.reason: 入选：核心基建方向，已核验来源与证据
papers.summary: MLPerf Inference v6.1新增端到端RAG和边缘多轮推理测试，将文档入库与查询问答分别测量，本轮共有30家提交组织。官方报告最优单加速器服务场景中，DeepSeek R1较一年前提升5.7倍，视觉语言模型较半年前提升2.99倍；这些是跨轮系统结果，不是单项软件优化的因果收益。
papers.key_insight: 社区UGC搜索可借鉴端到端RAG基准，把向量化、索引、重排和生成分阶段计时，同时保留整条链路延迟与质量门槛。硬件选型时固定数据量、输出长度和精度约束，再比较服务吞吐；公布的跨轮最佳成绩无法直接预测本业务成本，最终仍需使用真实查询和nDCG、CTR进行验证。

papers.title: FLEET: From Logits Entropy to Enhanced Trajectories in Text Generation
papers.abstract: Solutions based on large language models (LLMs) often rely on temperature sampling to improve accuracy and stability by aggregating multiple samples from the completion distribution. However, this memoryless approach is inherently suboptimal: because it lacks awareness of prior generations and their evaluations, it produces an increasing proportion of semantically duplicate answers as more samples are drawn, leading to diminishing returns. To address this limitation, we introduce FLEET, a novel method that integrates a memory mechanism into the generation process. FLEET represents each generation as a sparse trajectory through states whose entropy exceeds a predefined threshold and uses these trajectories to infer per-token utility scores that adjust the logits. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that FLEET achieves the same accuracy as the repeated sampling baseline, with a 3x speedup, and substantially improves accuracy on complex coding tasks (LiveCodeBench Pass@32 increases from 59.
papers.reason: 入选：核心基建方向，已核验来源与证据
papers.summary: FLEET针对多次温度采样反复生成相似答案的问题，只记录高熵状态形成的稀疏轨迹，再利用历史轨迹及评价调整 token logits。论文报告达到重复采样基线相同准确率时可加速3倍；相同预算下，LiveCodeBench的Pass@32从59.9%升至66.2%，并公开算法与实验代码。
papers.key_insight: 对于社区搜索离线生成查询改写或候选答案，可将采样预算集中到真正不同的生成分支，减少重复结果的验证成本。部署需要访问logits并维护轨迹状态，因此应先在可控开源推理栈试验；代码任务的Pass@32提升不能替代搜索相关性验证，还应测候选多样性与nDCG。

papers.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
papers.abstract: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.
papers.reason: 入选：核心基建方向，已核验来源与证据
papers.summary: OpenAI更新GPT-6提示缓存，支持30分钟窗口内符合条件的共享前缀复用，并增加命中监控、缺失诊断和显式断点。缓存输入 token 最高可享90%折扣；文章引用GitHub Copilot在数十亿请求上的经验，需重新计算的提示 token 占比较此前基线下降超过50%，属于厂商披露的生产证据。

papers.title: Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report
papers.authors: Tencent Hunyuan Team, Ao Liu, Botong Zhou, Can Xu, Chayse Zhou
papers.abstract: We present Hunyuan-A13B, an open-source large language model based on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It contains 80 billion total parameters but activates only 13 billion during inference, balancing model capability, computational efficiency, and deployment cost. The model is pretrained on a rigorously filtered 20T-token corpus with enhanced STEM data curation, improving factual reliability and reasoning ability. High-quality supervised fine-tuning and large-scale reinforcement learning further enhance its overall performance. Hunyuan-A13B also introduces a dual-mode Chain-of-Thought framework that adapts reasoning depth to task complexity: fast thinking for routine queries and slow thinking for complex, multi-step problems. Evaluations show competitive performance across mathematics, science, programming, general language understanding, and agent tasks, often approaching that of much larger models. Its high inference throughput makes it suitable for latency-sensitive applications.
papers.reason: 入选：核心基建方向，已核验来源与证据
papers.summary: 腾讯Hunyuan-A13B以800亿总参数、130亿激活参数的MoE架构降低每次推理计算，并通过快慢两种思考模式适配不同请求。模型使用20T token 预训练；报告中快速模式GPQA-Diamond为61.8，RULER长上下文QA平均76.7，64K至128K区间为73.9，提供开源部署参考。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索可把快速模式用于常规Query理解，把慢速模式留给复杂离线标注，并分别测延迟和相关性。稀疏激活降低计算量，但800亿总参数仍影响权重驻留与跨卡通信；先以真实短文本、长尾实体和中文口语测试nDCG，再评估批处理与KV缓存，不把通用基准分数当作CTR收益。

papers.title: Can One Adapted Model Do It All? Fine-Tuning Strategy Selection for Customer Support LLMs
papers.authors: Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Xue-Yong Fu, Shashi Bhushan TN
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27262v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Production customer-support systems often require LLMs to support multiple skills, such as intent classification, question answering, summarization, or tool-use decisions. A central deployment question is whether these skills should be handled by separate task-specialist models or by a single model trained through multi-task training, sequential updates, or model merging. We study this question using thirteen models spanning five families (Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Gemma-3, Llama-3.1, and Mistral) from 0.6B to 32B parameters across eight customer-support datasets, spanning four public and four proprietary datasets with approximately 74.5k training and 8.7k evaluation samples. Under a fixed training protocol, we train more than 200 checkpoints. Our experiments reveal that multi-task full fine-tuning is the strongest operational default at every model size we test. Specialist models are strong on their target tasks but often degrade sharply off-task
papers.reason: 入选：核心基建方向，已核验来源与证据
papers.summary: 论文比较客服多技能部署中的专用模型、多任务训练、顺序微调和模型合并，覆盖5个模型家族、13个0.6B至32B模型及8个数据集。作者使用约7.45万训练、8700评估样本训练200多个检查点，发现多任务全量微调在所有测试规模上都是最稳健的默认方案。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索常把意图识别、问题改写和摘要分别部署，可以借鉴统一多任务模型与专用模型路由的对照设计，评估维护成本和技能干扰。研究还发现顺序LoRA较全量顺序微调更能保留旧技能；但实验来自客服任务，迁移后仍需按搜索意图分桶验证nDCG与CTR。

papers.title: Distilling Sequential Computation in Transformer Language Models
papers.authors: Zixuan Lan, Jessica Yang, Yanhong Li, Karen Livescu, Jiawei Zhou
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27233v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Transformer language models process sequences token by token in an autoregressive manner, making growing contexts increasingly expensive. Yet many adjacent token spans are highly predictable or frequently occur as stable units, suggesting that their representations may be compressible. We introduce a method for distilling sequential computation by replacing spans of input tokens with collapsed representations, computed on the fly by a lightweight merge module. This module generates a single surrogate embedding from a sequence of static token embeddings that captures the functional role of the multiple tokens, allowing pretrained models to operate on compressed inputs without architectural changes or re-training. We apply this approach during inference to compress both prompts and intermediate decoding steps, using a rollback mechanism to substitute stored multi-token KV cache entries with their single-step surrogates. papers.summary: 论文针对长提示及生成过程的序列计算成本，用轻量合并模块将多个相邻 token 替换为单个代理 embedding。解码阶段通过回滚机制把多 token KV缓存替换成单步表示，无需修改主模型结构或重新训练；跨模型实验中，有效序列长度最多缩短40%，同时报告较小的任务精度损失。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可先在固定系统提示、重复模板和较长检索上下文上试验压缩，重点检查实体名、否定词和引用边界是否被代理表示损伤。40%指有效序列长度降幅，不能直接当作延迟降幅；需同时测合并模块开销、首词延迟、显存和下游nDCG或答案准确率。

papers.title: Six Layers Less: Encoder Pruning for Whisper with Label-Free Recovery
papers.abstract: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI's Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups. For instance, the {\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo} variant reduced the decoder from 32 to 4 layers, while Distill-Whisper similarly reduced the decoder to only 2 layers. Although some attention has been put towards reducing the size of the encoder, no approach has seen wide adoption. This could be due to the need for custom inference implementations to take advantage of the compressed model. We present an approach that ranks encoder layers by the leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate (WER). The six layers that cause the least change are removed, corresponding to 18.5% of the encoder stack. The pruned model requires no custom inference code as it is simply a more shallow encoder with fewer layers. papers.reason: 入选：核心基建方向，已核验来源与证据
papers.summary: 该研究根据逐层移除后的词错误率变化，删除Whisper编码器中影响最小的6层，再用无标注单语言语音蒸馏恢复能力。模型沿用普通浅层编码器实现，无需专用推理代码；四种语言平均WER从基线18.2%升至直接剪枝的21.9%，蒸馏后恢复到20.1%，仍存在精度代价。
papers.key_insight: 如果社区UGC包含语音帖子或语音查询，这种结构剪枝可降低转写服务复杂度，适合作为音频入库链路的压缩基线。需保留恢复后比原模型高1.9个百分点WER这一成本，重点评估方言、实体名及噪声语音；本文并未证明文本搜索nDCG改善，也不能按剪层比例推算端到端加速。

papers.title: Seal, Then Sample: Sampled Layerwise Proofs for Verifiable LLM Inference from GPT-2 to 70B
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27367v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Verifying outsourced language-model inference requires a precisely identified computation and an audit whose cost a service can afford. We present Sampled Layerwise Proofs (SLP), a protocol and prototype that commits the boundary activations of every chunk of an inference trace, absorbs all commitments before any challenge is drawn, and then proves a verifier-selected subset of chunks together with the chunks that bind the prompt and the answer. Audit coverage becomes a runtime parameter over one set of commitments: on a TinyLlama-1.1B trace, proving seven of 47 chunks takes 22.0% of the time and 6.8% of the proof size of proving all 47. Because proof cost is dominated by weights rather than tokens, SLP packs concurrent requests into one trace under a block-diagonal causal mask and binds the prompt and answer of each request to its slot.
